abstract:
|
  Fix cycle round 2 on issue #65's citation-resolver gate, addressing an Opus adversarial reviewer's 5-Major/5-Minor REJECT of round 1 (commit 3d76e65). Verified base first (HEAD 3d76e65, branch car/tooling-65) before any edit.

  The core theme across every Major: round 1 made claims about what the gate catches and what it verified without testing them, which is exactly the citation-truth defect class this gate exists to stop - a self-referential failure the reviewer's own summary called out directly. Round 2 replaces every such claim with a tested, honestly-stated one: the header now explicitly separates BINDING coverage (Class A dead path, Class B out-of-range) from what is NOT CAUGHT (in-range shifts), names the false inherited claim and corrects it, and fixes the three real citations that false claim had been covering for (docs/setup.md, docs/contracts/gating-matrix.md, and a shared target cited from two design/spec files) - all found by the reviewer opening files, none by the gate, because in-range shifts are precisely its disclosed blind spot.

  Five Minors closed with real mechanism changes: the unwrap boundary now requires a genuine wrap signature (word-char-before-hyphen or trailing slash, MINOR-1/5) rather than a bare hyphen that also matched 209 prose-dash lines; the content anchor is case-sensitive (MINOR-2); the ellipsis exemption now actually checks existence and range via suffix-match resolution instead of silently passing anything (MINOR-3, closing a demonstrated "a fabricated .../never-existed.md:3 passes" gap); and an ambiguous basename whose cited line exceeds every candidate's length now binds as a real defect (MINOR-4). Each is pinned with a red-first fixture or direct unit test.

  The most consequential correction is CHECK (c)'s content-anchor section: round 1 dismissed its two misses as confirming nothing, when in fact both were the exact Class-B defects MAJOR-3/4 later found manually. Round 2 states this plainly, argues report-only-vs-binding honestly using that record rather than erasing it, and sets a concrete, numeric trigger for when to revisit binding it - matching the governing rule the coordinator supplied: narrow or delete a wrong claim rather than inflate it, and state coverage as fact rather than reassurance.

  Fresh calibration (258 files, 188 coordinates, down from 192 because four citations were fixed into symbol/heading form and permanently removed from the population rather than patched to a false pass) shows zero new true flags from any widened or tightened check. All suites green at the new HEAD: scripts/tests 217/0/4-skipped/221, scripts/probes 24/24, Go 85/85 + go vet clean, Node 129/129, probe-yard-snapshot.mjs PASS.
